rows.text: Good morning. It's Tuesday, the third of March, and the house is still quiet. Take your time waking.
There's one thing to do today. The library books are due back at the Maple Street branch before it closes. And by Friday, Jordan is waiting on that packing list.
The dentist expects you at two this afternoon. Then, at half past six, dinner with Sam and Priya.
Outside, it will be partly sunny and cool, with a high of fifty-two. The rain waits until tomorrow.
In the news, a sample chip maker has opened a new plant. A sample central bank is holding its rates steady. And volunteers have finished surveying a sample cave.
That's all for now. Breathe slowly, and rise when you're ready.
